BiblicalUsage: Hem is the word for they, used when the people themselves are the point, and it is everywhere in the Old Testament. In 1 Samuel 3:1 the word of the Lord is precious and there is no open vision, in 1 Kings 1:41 Adonijah and his guests hear the sound of the city, and in 1 Chronicles 12:1 the men come to David at Ziklag.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the pronoun does quiet work: it gathers the people into one word, and the story is about what they do together.
